input.quote: 9.3 Customer may terminate an Order Form immediately if Vendor suffers a material Security Incident, repeatedly misses a critical service level, violates Applicable Law in performing the Services, or infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by Section 20.5.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no indemnity provision: Section 20 is absent entirely, and the only references to indemnity are cross-references (Section 9.3 points to a non-existent Section 20.5; Sections 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 assume indemnification obligations exist). With no Vendor IP indemnity, the clause sits in walk-away territory. We inserted a preferred-level Vendor defence and indemnity (IP infringement by Services or Deliverables, Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice, control and cooperation, plus a limit on any Customer indemnity. We targeted preferred rather than fallback because Section 21.3 already treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims (uncapped); importing the fallback 3x super-cap would reduce our existing protection.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 20 Vendor indemnity (IP, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), with notice/control/cooperation procedure and a narrow limit on any Customer indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added a Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct claims, with a standard notice, control, and cooperation procedure, and we have confined any Customer indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Customer shall give Vendor written notice of the claim, Vendor shall control its defence and settlement, and Customer shall provide reasonable cooperation. Any indemnity given by Customer under this Agreement is limited to third-party claims arising from content Customer provides to Vendor and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
